_comment: Which eval scenario asserts what, for THIS profile. The map used to be a
global in run-evals.sh while the corpus was already per-profile, so every
scenario was asserted against every profile and a second profile inherited
assertions about a repository it has nothing to do with. The gate was then
permanently red in that profile's own environment.
A scenario with no entry here FAILS. Opting out is written down, with a
reason, so it cannot happen by omission.
